title: ""
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
geometry: "a4paper,left=2.1cm,right=2.1cm,top=3.4cm,bottom=2cm,headheight=45pt,headsep=12pt"
fontsize: 10pt
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{fontspec}
  - \usepackage{graphicx}
  - \setmainfont{DejaVu Serif}
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage[table]{xcolor}
  - \makeatletter
  - \def\ps@senateurs{\def\@oddhead{\vbox{\hbox to\textwidth{\begin{minipage}[c]{0.78\textwidth}\small\bfseries\senateurstitre\\\normalfont\footnotesize\senateurssoustitre\end{minipage}\hfill\senateurslogo}\vskip 1pt\hrule}}\let\@evenhead\@oddhead\def\@oddfoot{\hfil\thepage\hfil}\let\@evenfoot\@oddfoot}
  - \makeatother
params:
  titre: ""
  sous_titre: ""
  logo: ""
  contenu: ""
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("\\gdef\\senateurstitre{", params$titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurssoustitre{", params$sous_titre, "}\n", sep = "")
if (nzchar(params$logo)) {
  cat("\\gdef\\senateurslogo{\\raisebox{-8pt}{\\includegraphics[height=0.78cm]{\\detokenize{",
      params$logo, "}}}}\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("\\gdef\\senateurslogo{}\n")
}
cat("\\pagestyle{senateurs}\n")
cat(params$contenu)
```
